narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On March 9, 2024, at approximately 1930 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at a laundromat in Holland, Michigan, after a citizen reported a person who appeared lost and distressed. The subject stated that he is a citizen of Mexico and that he has no papers to be in the United States.
ENTRY:
The subject stated that he paid a coyote in Ciudad Juarez the equivalent of four thousand dollars. The coyote led him and six others on foot across the border west of the Santa Teresa port of entry at about 0200 hours on 12/02/2022, avoiding any inspection, and a second smuggler drove the group to a stash house in El Paso.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Notice to Appear.
